title: D-087 PKT-K (C1): real-file architect PDF resolver - PDF 1.5+ cross-reference streams and object streams in a NEW profile-level module (never widening the shared read_object_table), with mandatory decompression guards and a real-corpus run
objective: The M5-T093 real-corpus trial read 0 of 6 real architect drawings: every file uses a PDF 1.5+ cross-reference STREAM plus object streams, which the reused strict reader (app/documents/extraction/pdf_xref.read_object_table, shared with the accepted survey pipeline) refuses. Build a NEW module services/api/app/drawings/pdf_object_streams.py that resolves cross-reference streams (/Type /XRef: /W field widths, /Index subsections, /Size, entry types 0/1/2, bounded /Prev chains with a cycle guard, hybrid-reference /XRefStm) and object streams (/Type /ObjStm: /N, /First, bounded object counts), including the PNG predictors ISO 32000-1 section 7.4.4.4 allows on these streams, and wire it through the sheet_reader facade / sheet_objects object graph so a classic-xref file still takes the old path unchanged. Every unsupported feature (encryption, other filters, TIFF predictor 2 if not implemented, broken offsets, etc.) is a typed refusal. Apply the plan's MANDATORY guard and the reader riders listed in the acceptance scenarios, then run the six real corpus items (fetched into scratch by URL, sha256-verified, NEVER committed) and report per file what now happens.
business_reason: The owner released PDF blueprint reading (D-087-R005); the reader must actually open real architect drawings before any wiring or owner claim, and the accepted plan names this resolver as the next reader step with a mandatory zip-bomb guard.
